description: Stations can suffer from fluctuations of use, including overcrowding during peak times and emptiness during non-peak times.

design_principle_name: Suitable general layout of the station and city
description: This principle focuses on creating a layout that accommodates both city and station needs efficiently.
This principle emphasizes separating non-transport functions to reduce overcrowding.

design_principle_name: Vibrate city environment by scattered mobility nodes
description: Introduces scattered mobility nodes to enhance the vibrancy of the city environment.

design_principle_name: Increase accommodating capacity by scattered mobility nodes
description: Uses scattered mobility nodes to increase the station's capacity to accommodate passengers.

design_principle_name: Make events visible by aligning main paths and open spaces
description: Enhances visibility of events by aligning main paths and open spaces.
